title: Enterprise to equity per-share bridge
one_liner: Translate operating-asset value into diluted per-share common equity without omitting or double counting nonoperating assets and claims.

selection.atomic_user_problem: Convert enterprise or operating-asset value into the correct value for one common share.
selection.distinctive_value: Encodes claim, unit, growth/reinvestment, terminal, bridge and stop-condition checks that are commonly omitted in ad hoc valuation.

source_faithfulness.rationale: Core doctrine is directly supported at the cited chapter/line anchors; workflow routing and current-data requirements are explicitly operational synthesis.

executability.rationale: The card has explicit inputs, ordered actions, observable outputs and hard stop conditions.

incremental_utility.comparison: The package-level release evaluation does not provide per-card attribution; individual behavioral evidence for this reference-only card remains pending.

falsifiable_boundedness.rationale: Non-use cases and invalid-input conditions alter routing or force a stop.

repetition_or_novelty.rationale: The governing consistency principles recur across multiple chapters; specific formulas remain valuable even when stated once.

do_not_trigger: Valuing only a stand-alone asset with no capital structure.

reading.locator: Chapter 16 > Firm Value and Equity Value > TXT lines 12232-12595
reading.paraphrase: Move from operating assets to equity by separately valuing cash/nonoperating holdings and subtracting non-equity claims at value, not by mechanically using book amounts.
reading.note: Source-grounded doctrine; runtime current-data and workflow adaptations are analyst inferences.

reading.locator: Chapter 16 > Cross Holdings and Minority Interests > formulas TXT lines 12464-12499
reading.paraphrase: Consolidated operating value must be reconciled with market-valued minority interests and cross-holdings without double counting.
reading.note: Source-grounded doctrine; runtime current-data and workflow adaptations are analyst inferences.

reading.locator: Chapter 16 > Stock-Based Compensation > formulas TXT lines 12655-12706
reading.paraphrase: Employee options and restricted shares require explicit dilution treatment; aggregate equity value and share count must be adjusted consistently.
reading.note: Source-grounded doctrine; runtime current-data and workflow adaptations are analyst inferences.
